notes: attn_total/mlp_total are summed per-layer Frobenius norms of the LoRA delta DIFFERENCE (||delta_b - delta_a||) across all 32 layers, grouped into attention projections (q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj) vs MLP projections (gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj). ratio_mlp_over_attn rises across all three transitions (1.355 -> 1.620 -> 1.772), i.e. even during the recovery leg (trough->recovery, where R_ctx partially climbs back up), the weight movement is STILL more MLP-concentrated than attention-concentrated, and more so than the initial baseline->peak rise. This is a single-seed, single seed-per-dataset observation only -- not yet causally validated (see mechanistic-diff-plan memory).
